text:
rachel: Planning a 45m hands-on "Minilab" on Jun 22. Goal: drive quick activation by bundling persona prompt packs + small credits. Want a simple 3-arm test and routing.

ben: Arms: 1) baseline follow-up (docs + examples) 2) persona prompt pack only 3) persona pack + 40 starter credits + 48h in-app toast nudge. Hypothesis: 3 increases first-success rate most.

kevin: Metrics: registered, attended, pack_downloaded, credits_granted, credits_redeemed, first_success, active_7d. Also tokens_first_week. Need cohort_id on all events.

rachel: Form UX: persona dropdown (Product/Data/Infra) + opt-in checkbox for credits. Routing: persona -> nurture list; include "preferred_model" + "fallback_model" fields in webhook.

ben: Sample webhook payload to inbound endpoint (for devs):
```json
{"event":"minilab_registered","email":"{{email}}","persona":"product","cohort_id":"minilab-jun22-v3","preferred_model":"redwood-led-1","fallback_model":"redwood-hosted-std"}
```

kevin: Ops notes: cap campaign to $6k credits, alert #finance at 75% consumption, auto-stop grant when cap hit. Also log model_used on credits_redeemed event.

ops-bot: Calendar invite created for 2026-06-22. Reminders: 48h, 2h.

rachel: Copy + social drafts: short hero line + benchmark teaser slide showing "sample before vs after" (tokens/query, latency, est cost). Example blurb: "Starter prompts: 0.04$/session -> 0.01$/session" (demo numbers).

ben: UX experiment: show a temporary header button "Use starter credits" for 5 days vs none; run on 30% of arm 3. Keep sample sizes small to control spend.

kevin: Deliverables: tracking doc & cohort ids (analytics), prompt packs (ben), landing + email copy (rachel), cap enforcement (infra). Deadlines: EOD Thu. Quick check-in 9:30am tomorrow?

rachel: Sounds good. Posting draft copy to #marketing-drafts in a bit. Thanks everyone :sparkles:
